title_en: Opinions of the Supreme People's Court on Providing Judicial Services and Safeguards for the Integrated Development of the Yangtze River Delta Region
full_text_en:
Supreme People's Court

Opinions on Providing Judicial Services and Guarantees for the Integrated Development of the Yangtze River Delta Region

Fa Fa [2020] No. 22

In order to thoroughly study and implement Xi Jinping Thought on Socialism with Chinese Characteristics for a New Era, fully implement the spirit of the 19th National Congress of the Communist Party of China and the Second, Third, and Fourth Plenary Sessions of the 19th Central Committee, earnestly implement the requirements of the "Outline of the Yangtze River Delta Regional Integration Development Plan" issued by the CPC Central Committee and the State Council, give full play to the function of adjudication, and provide judicial services and guarantees for the integrated development of the Yangtze River Delta (hereinafter referred to as the YRD) region in accordance with the law, these opinions are formulated in light of the actual work of the people's courts.

1. Conscientiously enhance the consciousness, initiative, coordination, and foresight of providing judicial services and guarantees for the integrated development of the YRD. Supporting the integrated development of the YRD and elevating it to a national strategy is a major decision and deployment made by the CPC Central Committee with Comrade Xi Jinping at its core. It is a major strategic measure to lead the nation's high-quality development, improve the spatial layout of China's reform and opening up, and build a strong and active growth pole for China's development. People's courts at all levels must adhere to Xi Jinping Thought on Socialism with Chinese Characteristics for a New Era as a guide, enhance the "Four Consciousnesses," strengthen the "Four Matters of Confidence," and achieve the "Two Upholds." They must always stand at the strategic height of the overall development of the Party and the national cause, deeply understand the major practical significance and far-reaching historical significance of the CPC Central Committee's promotion of the integrated development of the YRD. They must continuously enhance the consciousness, initiative, coordination, and foresight of providing judicial services and guarantees for the integrated development of the YRD in accordance with the law, improve judicial service guarantee policies and measures, and strive to meet the new judicial needs of YRD integration.

2. Accurately grasp the entry points, integration points, and focal points of judicial services and guarantees for the integrated development of the YRD. In accordance with the guiding ideology, basic principles, strategic positioning, and development goals set forth in the "Outline of the Yangtze River Delta Regional Integration Development Plan," closely adhere to the two keys of "integration" and "high quality," and actively serve to make a great article on integrated development. Focusing on key areas such as promoting the formation of a new pattern of coordinated regional development, strengthening the construction of a collaborative innovation industrial system, enhancing the level of infrastructure interconnection, strengthening the co-protection and co-governance of the ecological environment, accelerating the convenient sharing of public services, promoting a higher level of coordinated opening up, and innovating the institutional mechanisms for integrated development; focusing on key regions such as the high-level construction of the YRD Ecological Green Integrated Development Demonstration Zone and the high-standard construction of the Lingang New Area of the China (Shanghai) Pilot Free Trade Zone; closely monitoring the development needs of cross-regional, cross-field, and cross-provincial functional adjustments, innovation integration, interconnection, co-protection and co-governance, and integrated collaboration; effectively identify the entry points, integration points, and focal points for judicial services and guarantees. Deeply study new situations and new problems, actively explore the institutional mechanisms for the integrated operation of regional judicial services, accelerate the modernization of the trial system and trial capacity, and provide precise judicial services and guarantees for the integrated development of the YRD.

3. Punish all types of crimes according to law, and resolutely maintain the security and stability of the economic and social environment of the YRD region. Give full play to the role of criminal adjudication functions, and legally adjudicate criminal cases in the YRD region involving key areas such as international investment, international trade, finance, intellectual property, production safety, public order, ecological environment, and personnel entry and exit. Severely punish criminal acts such as illegal cross-border transfer and dumping of hazardous waste, and severely punish crimes that interfere with and disrupt the integrated development of the YRD's science and innovation industry, industrial project construction, etc. Strengthen the linkage and cooperation in handling major cross-regional criminal cases such as anti-money laundering and illegal fund-raising, forming a joint force to combat crime.

4. Enhance the professional level of civil and commercial adjudication, and promote the optimization of the legalized business environment in the YRD region. Give full play to the role of civil adjudication functions, correctly implement the Civil Code, effectively improve the quality and efficiency of civil case trials, protect legitimate civil rights from infringement, and promote harmonious and orderly civil relations. Increase the intensity of judicial protection of property rights, properly adjudicate cases involving private enterprises, legally and equally protect all types of property rights, and promote the creation of a stable, fair, transparent, and predictable legalized business environment. Improve the working mechanism for adjudicating major civil and commercial cases across administrative regions, pay close attention to the impact of financial policies and new financing methods on the economic and social development of the YRD region, legally and properly adjudicate cases such as private lending and internet finance, support coordinated reforms in the financial field, promote the prevention and mitigation of financial risks, and maintain financial innovation and financial security. Legally and properly adjudicate cases in the YRD region involving education, employment, medical care, culture, and social security, promote the convenient sharing of public services, and ensure that the fruits of integrated development benefit the people more and more fairly. Actively serve the structural reform of the supply side, legally adjudicate cases arising from the integrated development of the science and innovation industry, the agglomeration of high-end factors, the adjustment and upgrading of the industrial structure, the elimination of backward production capacity, and the undertaking of industrial transfers, promote the establishment of a coordinated mechanism for bankruptcy disposal, and legally promote the optimization and upgrading of the YRD region's industries.

5. Optimize the allocation of administrative adjudication resources in the YRD region, and support and supervise administrative organs in administering according to law. Legally adjudicate administrative cases arising from the construction of integrated comprehensive transportation systems, inter-provincial major water conservancy projects, urban functional area construction, municipal public facilities and other infrastructure construction, as well as housing renovation and new residential area construction, supporting and supervising administrative organs in administering according to law. Properly resolve administrative disputes arising in areas such as regional coordinated development, urban-rural integrated development, metropolitan area integration development, regional urban integration development, and ecological economic belt construction due to land reform and regional benefit sharing. Establish and improve a new mechanism for benign interaction between the judiciary and administration that is compatible with administrative case jurisdiction reform and administrative institution reform, serving and guaranteeing the reform of "streamlining administration, delegating power, improving regulation, and upgrading services." Improve the administrative dispute mediation mechanism, promote the comprehensive strengthening of coordination and cooperation among administrative dispute mediation centers within the region, and facilitate the substantive resolution of administrative disputes.

6. Strengthen judicial protection of intellectual property rights, and promote the construction of a collaborative innovation industrial system in the YRD region. Legally adjudicate various types of intellectual property cases, increase the intensity of punishment for intellectual property infringement, protect innovation achievements, and serve the construction of an internationally competitive advanced manufacturing cluster and the creation of a global innovation achievement distribution center. Strengthen judicial protection of rights and data such as patents, copyrights, and enterprise trade secrets, and legally support the development of modern information technologies such as 5G, blockchain, cloud computing, and the Internet of Things. Explore the establishment of a diversified technical fact-finding talent team and a collaborative mechanism for technical fact-finding, and promote the consistency of intellectual property authorization and confirmation standards, administrative enforcement standards, and judicial standards. Strengthen joint protection of intellectual property, increase judicial protection for innovation communities and industrial clusters in fields such as electronic information, biomedicine, high-end equipment, new energy, and new materials, and collaboratively promote original innovation, technological innovation, and industrial innovation, helping to build a science and technology innovation community in the YRD region.

7. Strengthen judicial protection of environmental resources, and ensure the green and integrated development of the YRD ecology. Give full play to the role of environmental resource adjudication functions, actively expand the radiation effect of the courts in the YRD Ecological Green Integrated Development Demonstration Zone in Qingpu, Shanghai; Wujiang, Jiangsu; and Jiashan, Zhejiang, gather effective adjudication resources, and build a judicial cooperation mechanism for ecological environmental protection in the YRD region. Actively respond to the development needs of the overall protection of the ecological environment across river basins and regions such as the Yangtze River, the Beijing-Hangzhou Grand Canal, the Xin'an River, the Huaihe River, and Taihu Lake, promote the professional construction of environmental resource adjudication, explore the establishment of a centralized jurisdiction system for environmental resource cases, and improve the cross-basin and cross-regional ecological compensation mechanism. Adhere to the concept of preventive and restorative justice, increase the intensity of adjudication of environmental public interest litigation and ecological environmental damage compensation cases, promote the construction of a green and beautiful YRD, and promote the harmonious coexistence of humans and nature.

8. Give play to the role of foreign-related commercial and maritime adjudication functions, and serve the higher level of opening up of the YRD region. Fairly and efficiently adjudicate foreign-related commercial and maritime cases in accordance with the law, especially various disputes arising in the fields of international economic cooperation and investment in the YRD region, and equally protect the legitimate rights and interests of Chinese and foreign parties. Give full play to the functions of maritime courts, legally adjudicate maritime and maritime cases such as international carriage of goods by sea, domestic carriage of goods by water, port and wharf construction, shipbuilding, warehousing and logistics, and marine environmental pollution cases, legally ensure the construction of important port areas such as Shanghai Yangshan Port, Ningbo Zhoushan Port, and the Lianyungang East-Central-West Regional Cooperation Demonstration Zone port, and serve the implementation of the maritime power strategy.

9. Improve the cross-regional judicial enforcement linkage and cooperation mechanism, and promote the construction of integrity in the YRD region. Promote the sharing of information on enforcement cases in the YRD region, strengthen the seamless connection of information-based investigation and control and assistance enforcement networks, and achieve full coverage of enforcement measures. Strengthen the construction of an enforcement command system with cross-regional command, management, and coordination, build a unified and complete enforcement coordination and command platform, and improve the ability to respond and handle enforcement in complex environments. Increase the intensity of assistance in cross-regional enforcement, simplify cross-regional enforcement procedures, unify the entrusted enforcement process, expand the scope of entrusted matters, and promote more fair and efficient property realization and other work. Establish a unified standard mechanism for the connection between enforcement and bankruptcy, unify cross-regional transfer standards, improve the operational efficiency of the enforcement-to-bankruptcy mechanism, and provide strong judicial guarantees for promoting the market clearing of "zombie enterprises." Improve the cross-regional credit joint supervision, warning, and punishment mechanism, establish a credit management mechanism for rewarding integrity and punishing dishonesty, and accelerate the construction of the YRD region's credit system.

10. Strengthen litigation service collaboration in the YRD region, and strive to provide high-quality, convenient, and efficient judicial services. Enhance the ability and level of cross-regional litigation services, and realize the non-differentiated acceptance and standard processing of litigants' claims in the courts of the YRD region. Improve the two platforms of "one-network access to services" and "one-network unified management." Externally, based on the China Mobile Micro Court, actively implement litigation services of "one-network access to services," providing litigants with convenient litigation services such as online case filing; internally, under the leadership of the litigation service guidance center information platform, effectively operate the litigation mechanism of "one-network unified management." Build a working mechanism for entrusted service within the entire YRD region with clear rules, strengthen the construction of a collaboration platform for entrusted litigation matters, and strengthen cross-regional and cross-level linkage and cooperation in property preservation, investigation and evidence collection, joint mediation, entrusted appraisal, and service of documents, providing the public with comprehensive, convenient, and diversified judicial services.

11. Increase the intensity of substantive resolution of disputes, and promote the construction of peace and safety in the YRD region. Persist in putting non-litigation dispute resolution mechanisms first, adhere to and develop the "Fengqiao Experience" in the new era, promote the establishment of grassroots social dispute mediation and resolution centers, and improve the comprehensive mechanism for multiple prevention, mediation, and resolution of social disputes. Comprehensively promote the construction of a one-stop diversified dispute resolution and litigation service system, establish a modern litigation service system that is intensive, efficient, diversified, convenient, wise, precise, open, interactive, integrated, and shared, and comprehensively standardize diversified dispute resolution, diversion, adjudication, case filing services, trial assistance, and litigation-related petitions. Promote the improvement of multi-departmental consultation mechanisms under the leadership of local party committees or the guidance of governments in the YRD region, give full play to the role of third-party social forces such as lawyers and other professionals in participating in dispute resolution, strengthen data sharing and business collaboration, and form a joint force for dispute resolution.

12. Strengthen international judicial services, and promote the creation of a good employment and entrepreneurship environment in the YRD region. Taking the "Belt and Road" initiative as the guide, focusing on the construction of international cooperation parks in the YRD region, promote the construction of a diversified dispute resolution platform for labor and personnel disputes, legally and properly handle labor and personnel disputes involving high-end talents in key areas, and promote the establishment of standardized, orderly, fair, reasonable, mutually beneficial, win-win, harmonious, and stable labor relations. Accelerate the establishment of a diversified international commercial dispute resolution platform mechanism, encourage commercial mediation institutions to participate in mediating disputes in international commerce, maritime affairs, investment, intellectual property, and other fields, widely use online mediation methods, provide efficient, convenient, and low-cost dispute resolution channels for Chinese and foreign parties, improve the diversified dispute resolution mechanism that connects mediation, arbitration, and litigation, and provide high-quality judicial services for the construction of the YRD region's free trade pilot zones.

13. Strengthen the construction of smart court application systems, and actively promote the development of judicial informatization in the YRD region. Build a smart court information data resource sharing platform in the YRD region, promote the establishment of a judicial big data center in the YRD region, strengthen the construction of judicial blockchain, eliminate information barriers for cross-regional law enforcement and case handling, promote the cross-regional online exchange, circulation, and sharing of case handling information, and provide strong data support for cross-regional litigation services, court trials, electronic service, enforcement collaboration, property rights transactions, and social credit system construction. Innovate the management methods of information-based adjudication, promote the in-depth application of modern technologies such as artificial intelligence in the judicial field, optimize the functional settings of intelligent auxiliary case handling systems, and continuously improve the quality and efficiency of trials.

14. Improve the YRD region inter-court meeting mechanism, and promote the innovative development of integrated regional judicial services. In view of the characteristics of cross-regional, cross-field, and cross-provincial functional adjustments, innovation integration, interconnection, co-protection and co-governance, and integrated collaboration in the YRD region, give full play to the functions of the Third Circuit Court of the Supreme People's Court, regularly hold inter-court meetings of the four courts in the YRD region, carefully study new situations and new problems, innovate and improve working mechanisms, promptly release typical cases, and actively explore the system model for the integrated operation of regional judicial services. Strengthen the construction of the inter-court meeting mechanism, and do a good job in daily communication, coordination, consultation, and linkage among the four courts in the YRD region. The inter-court meeting focuses on researching and coordinating the resolution of major judicial matters, judicial needs, judicial policies, and major difficult legal application issues in the integrated development of the YRD, and promotes the uniformity of judicial adjudication standards.

15. Promote the optimal allocation of judicial resources in the YRD region, and strive to promote the modernization of the trial system and trial capacity. Actively promote the effective flow and optimal allocation of judicial resources in the YRD region, explore the establishment of a judge exchange working mechanism based on trial business exchange, and carry out hierarchical and specialized counterpart exchanges, appointments, and use. In accordance with the requirements of the pilot work, further optimize the allocation of judicial resources, carry out the reform of the diversion of simplified and complex procedures in civil and administrative litigation procedures in an orderly manner, and promote the realization of case diversion, separation of important and minor matters, and fast and slow tracks. In view of the economic and social development situation and case type characteristics of the YRD region, give full play to the advantages of judicial resources in the YRD region, further improve the centralized jurisdiction or specialized jurisdiction trial mechanism for cases with strong professional nature such as intellectual property, finance, maritime, and internet, and continuously improve the level of specialized adjudication in the YRD region.

Supreme People's Court

July 10, 2020
